pages.text: Start with ordinary vanilla mushrooms. Look in dark forests, shady caves, swamps, mushroom fields, or the Nether. Keep red and brown mushrooms separate when drying.

pages.title: Renewable Supply
pages.text: Grow them on mycelium, podzol or nylium, or in a dim area on suitable solid blocks. With room and a valid floor, bonemeal can grow a giant mushroom. Break the cap for regular mushrooms.

pages.title: From Wild to Magic
pages.text: Dry nine of one color on a $(l:psychedelicraft:processing/drying)drying table$(/l) for three matching magic mushrooms. Dealer stock at tier three can also supply them. They share growth and mob effects.
